question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. Main source of water for Wular Lake is River Jhelum.

Q. Wular Lake is also said to be a remnant of Satisar Lake that existed in ancient times.

R. This lake also has a small island in its centre called the ‘Zaina Lank’.

S. This island was constructed by King Zainul-Abi-Din.
solution:
The correct answer is "PRSQ"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement P is the opening sentence of the passage which says that the River Jhelum is the main source of water for Wular Lake.
 
• Statement R is the second sentence of the passage which explains that the 'Zaina Lank' is a little island in the centre of the lake.
 
• Statement S is the third sentence of the passage which explains that the island was built by King Zainul-Abi-Din.
 
• Statement Q is the last sentence of the passage which shows that Wular Lake is also considered to be a relic of Satisar Lake from ancient times.

Hence, the correct sequence is P, R, S, Q

The correct answer is option 4.

The correct passage is: ***P**. Main source of water for Wular Lake is River Jhelum. **R**. This lake also has a small island in its centre called the ‘Zaina Lank’. **S**. This island was constructed by King Zainul-Abi-Din. **Q**. Wular Lake is also said to be a remnant of Satisar Lake that existed in ancient times.*
